Players Committee card image of [[Kylo Ren (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “Adds one destiny to total power when with a [First Order] shuttle. While present at a battleground, Honor Of The Jedi is suspended. Whenever a player loses a battle here, that player loses 2 Force. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/kylorenwb.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f7bfb21d839c1980be695d39782635714935dfe 6f7bfb2] (5 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
